title: Likelihood Displacement as a Causal Link from Safety DPO to Reduced Refusals

original_idea.body:
# Likelihood Displacement from Safety DPO to Reduced Refusals

**Problem:** Safety DPO can paradoxically reduce refusal via likelihood displacement; prevalence and predictors are under-studied.

**Direction:** Run small safety DPO varying chosen/rejected similarity, track refusal before/after, correlate displacement with embedding similarity.

**Why it matters:** Practitioners need a simple diagnostic to avoid backfiring safety DPO.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2410.08847.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A simple diagnostic to avoid safety-DPO backfiring is actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small safety-DPO LoRA runs plus embedding-similarity correlation; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: vary chosen/rejected similarity, correlate with displacement, clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: DPO is runnable by small teams; no lab infra needed.

low_compute.reasoning: Small DPO LoRA runs on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Razin et al. showed the effect; the similarity-predictor stress test across datasets may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Effect shown; cross-dataset similarity-predictor angle may be open.
